An '''indicator function''' selects elements based on specific criteria.

== General form ==

If set $A$ encompasses all elements satisfying certain criteria, its indicator function

$$
\mathbf{1}_A(x)=
\begin{cases}
1,& x\in A,\\
0,& x\notin A.
\end{cases}
$$

== Composition ==

$$
\mathbf{1}_{A\cap B}(x)=\mathbf{1}_A(x)\cdot \mathbf{1}_B(x)\\
\mathbf{1}_{A\cup B}(x)=\mathbf{1}_A(x)+\mathbf{1}_B(x) - \mathbf{1}_{A\cap B}(x)=\mathbf{1}_A(x)+\mathbf{1}_B(x) - \mathbf{1}_A(x)\cdot \mathbf{1}_B(x)\\
$$
